name: @iris/desktop
description: Secure attached-only desktop shell for the JarvisOS runtime
author: Iris v2 Project

scripts.build:workspace-deps: npm run build --workspace @iris/contracts && npm run build --workspace @iris/jarvis-adapter && npm run build --workspace @iris/gesture-runtime && npm run build --workspace @iris/gemini-bridge
scripts.build: npm run prepare:mediapipe && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/bundle-preload.mjs && vite build
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:mediapipe && node scripts/bundle-preload.mjs && concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist/electron/main/main.js && electron dist/electron/main/main.js --dev"
scripts.package:win: npm run build:workspace-deps && npm run build && node scripts/prepare-electron-dist.mjs && electron-builder --win --dir && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
